commit.message:
fix(browser): rollover-aware settle transitions (Windows E2E interleaving)

A requested rollover was silently dropped when the ambiguity recovery
resolved or retired the same pending wake right after the request:
those paths settled straight back to WAITING, prepared a fresh wake
and the rollover was lost until the next trigger (live-observed as the
Windows E2E interleaving — rollover requested inside sendWake, then
resolveAmbiguous overwrote ROLLOVER_REQUIRED).

Every settle transition (resolveAmbiguous, markCycleComplete,
retireAmbiguousAfterTerminal) now routes through settleState(), which
preserves ROLLOVER_REQUIRED/DEFERRED while a rollover request is
outstanding. confirmWakeSent additionally clears an unexecuted
composer-uncleanable rollover request — a confirmed send proves the
bound composer works and the rollover is obsolete.

Full suite: 2403 pass / 0 fail / 2 skip. npm run check clean.
